description: Review selected non-sensitive claims and source excerpts for security and procurement work. DigiTrust Evidence Assistant maps claims to supplied evidence, flags missing source details, checks exact quotations and supplied dates, and produces focused reviewer questions. Results help you organize a review; they do not verify factual truth, source authenticity, compliance or permission to share. Synthetic examples are also available. The Assistant does not access private workspaces, fetch source links, retain submitted review content in application storage, or approve external use. Share only material you have explicitly confirmed is non-sensitive and permitted to send to DigiTrans.
